note: Template for the owner's tools registry. Copy it to ~/.config/model-mesh/superloop-tools.json (or point MM_SUPERLOOP_TOOLS at it), outside every worktree and out of the worker's reach, and replace each pin with the SHA-256 of the installed file, for example sha256sum "$(command -v goose)". The driver hashes every pin again right before each call and refuses a mismatch. The reviewer prints its findings as a JSON list on the last line of standard output. The goose argv is a sketch: its recipe and --params flags were not checked against a goose install, and neither was the opencode export output. The omo entry path under node_modules is illustrative; find the real one in your install. OWNER is a placeholder. bwrap is the pinned bubblewrap used for the worker jail and the check jail. The worker's writable folders are where the harness keeps its state; the two shown are a guess, not checked against opencode.
